references.text: Jesus uses the example of David eating the showbread, which was forbidden, to explain that human needs can override religious regulations, a principle also reflected in Jesus' teaching against blindly following the teachings of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
Jesus warns against false prophets and teaches that they are known by their fruits, which connects with His warning against the teachings of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
The Lord criticizes the people for their empty rituals and lack of genuine devotion, echoing Jesus' critique of the superficial religiosity of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
Micah criticizes Israel's leaders for their injustice and falsehood, which relates to Jesus' warnings against the teachings of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
